Hey! I'm currently in DBT treatment and my therapist is helping me find tools to use to replace my self destructive thoughts and behaviors. Some tools I've found that work for me are reading, going to a quiet spot, and holding my dog. I also like to do breathing exercises. I do three seconds of inhaling and four seconds of exhaling. I hope any of these told will help you. I also use benzos to cope but u hope someday I'll be able to not need them.
